content_metadata.description: In this detailed video analysis, we examine an interview on 'Lou Dobbs Tonight' featuring Donald Trump during the 2016 presidential race. The video provides insights into Trump's campaign strategy, his interactions with the GOP establishment, and his perspectives on political figures and events.

who has dominated the GOP polls, and it looks as though the nomination is now his to lose.
Tonight we're joined by none other than Donald Trump and Donald Good to talk with you.
You've got to be feeling pretty good about where the polls have you and your prospects right now.
Well, I do, and we'll see what happens, but certainly we have a long road to go.
It's just in a way it's just beginning. We've had over a hundred days, there's number one,
and all of the big national polls, and we had some good ones come out over the last couple of days,
so, but we'll see it's still a long road. You know, you continue to surprise nearly all of the

look, I think I'm a nice person. I like to be a nice person. Perhaps I've tempered it a little
bit. Went to an Ivy League school. I'm supposed to be a smart person, so I should be able to
temper it if I have to. But, you know, we're just in this position. You know, my whole concept and
my whole theme is make America great again, and people, it's been resonating with everybody.
Amazingly, we have tremendous turnouts. We were in Iowa last night, New Hampshire two days ago,
we were in South Carolina all over, and we're getting tremendous record turnouts, and people want to

That's probably what they do. I've been involved in politics for a long time, but generally,
is what they do. I will hit back very, very hard. You know, a lot of this money that comes in,
it's come in by all sorts of different groups, including lobbyists and special interests.
It's not the candidate's money, and the lobbyists won't be able to deal with me like they
deal with the politician, because politicians basically are puppets for the lobbyists. That's one
of the reasons the country's in such trouble. And we'll see what happens, but we will hit back
very hard that I can tell you. Well, let's talk about a few developments today amongst them.
Paul Ryan saying he's ready to be speaker now that he has the conservative wing of the Republican

or would it be a problem? Well, no, I think he can be worked with absolutely. It sounds like it's
